quests.title: Four Barges
quests.description: Kill Stormscale Naga Raiders on the Scoured Coast and recover the Barge Nameboards they've taken.
quests.accept_text:
Four of my barges never arrived, and I think the naga have them.

The current off the landing runs north along the west shore. Anything that sinks in the bay washes up on the Scoured Coast, and the Stormscale Naga Raiders have been there since the sea route opened three years ago. They keep trophies, so they'll have the nameboards.

Leave by the town gate and cross the Ashen Reach to its far west shore, past the Cinder Flats. Kill the Raiders and bring back any nameboards you find.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are all four of them.

So the naga had them. What I don't know is whether they found them wrecked or wrecked them. Take these boards to Adjuster Raman at the Merchant House. Working that out is her job.

quests.title: Bad Luck or Bad Seamanship
quests.description: Examine the two barge wrecks on the Scoured Coast and collect Naga Boarding Hooks from the Stormscale Naga Raiders.

objectives.label: the northern barge wreck on the Scoured Coast
the southern barge wreck on the Scoured Coast

quests.accept_text:
The Harbourmaster says naga sank those barges and the Underwriter says her pilots did. I'm paid to find out which.

I did this work for nine years in Singapore before I came through. A barge that ran aground is holed underneath. A barge that was boarded is damaged along the rail.

Two of the wrecks are lying on the Scoured Coast, on the far west shore of the Reach, a good walk apart. Look at where each hull is broken. Bring me some of the hooks the Raiders carry as well, so I can match them to the damage.
quests.turn_in_text:
Both hulls are sound underneath and both rails are torn up.

These hooks have pine splinters in them, and the barges were pine. They were boarded while they were afloat. Raiders who only scavenge don't carry gear like this, so someone is organising them.

quests.description: Kill Wreck-Captain Vess'ira on the Scoured Coast.
quests.accept_text:
The Adjuster's report names someone the coast surveyor has been telling me about for months.

She says a naga gives the orders from the old wrecks, and she calls it Wreck-Captain Vess'ira. The raiders bring everything they take back to it.

It stays on the Scoured Coast on the west shore of the Reach. It'll come out for someone who's hunting it. My crews won't sail until it's dead.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's its helm. It was wearing one of my berth tags.

I'll post the news on the wharf tonight and the pilots will sign on again. Thank you. This is from the harbour office.

objectives.label: the coast chart, to Harbourmaster Skezz in Cinderwharf

quests.accept_text:
I've finished my chart of this coast and it needs to get to Harbourmaster Skezz.

The last two times I tried to take it myself I lost a boat. She needs it before she sends another barge round the west side.

Cinderwharf is on the north-east shore. Head east across the Cinder Flats to the town gate. She's on the wharf at the north end of town.
quests.turn_in_text:
Every reef and wreck is marked on this.

Nobody has had a chart of this coast since the sea route opened three years ago. I'll send the surveyor a bottle to say thank you. Take something from the harbour office.

quests.title: Older Than the Ashclaim
quests.description: Collect Barnacled Brass Fittings from the Scourcoast Crabs on the Scoured Coast.
quests.accept_text:
Someone was sailing to this island long before the goblins found it, and I'd like to know who.

The old wrecks on this shore are oak and brass, and the brass is better than anything my people cast. The Scourcoast Crabs pick the fittings off and carry them around.

They're all along the waterline, north and south of here. Bring me some of the fittings and I'll look for a maker's mark.
quests.turn_in_text:
There's a mark on this one. It's a hammer over a flame.

That's the old seal of Khaz Varun. The dwarves had ships and traded from this coast before their city went dark. The Thane will want to hear about this.

quests.description: Collect Balls of Vent Tar from the Tarfoot Gorillas in the open ash country of the Ashen Reach.
quests.accept_text:
My last two boats both leak and I've got no pitch to seal them.

There's tar on this island, though. It seeps up warm round the vents, and the Tarfoot Gorillas walk through it until their feet are caked in it.

They're in the open ash country east of this coast, between here and the Works. Bring me the tar off their feet.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's good tar, and it's still soft.

I'll have both hulls sealed by tomorrow. Thank you. Take this, it washed up last week.

quests.description: Carry the gate's weigh book to Assayer Ruddi at the Ashclaim Works.

objectives.label: the gate weigh book, to Assayer Ruddi at the Ashclaim Works

quests.accept_text:
If you're going out to the Works, can you take the weigh book with you?

I weigh every cart of ore that comes through this gate. Assayer Ruddi weighs the same carts when they leave the Works. If his book and hers don't match, someone's stealing on the road.

The Works is a long walk west of here, past the Cinder Flats. Follow the cart ruts.
quests.turn_in_text:
His numbers match mine for every cart this month.

So nobody's stealing on the road. The ore we're missing is going missing before it reaches my scales. Come back and see me once you've had a look round the yard.

quests.title: Sixty People
quests.description: Kill Sulphur Raptors and Ashplain Basilisks on the Cinder Flats, along the ore road.
quests.accept_text:
I've got sixty people in this yard, and I'd like to keep all of them.

The ore goes out by cart across the Cinder Flats to the town gate. The Sulphur Raptors run down the carts for the mules. The Ashplain Basilisks lie in the ruts looking like rock until a carter steps on one.

The Flats are north-east of the yard. Walk the cart road and kill what's on it.
quests.turn_in_text:
The afternoon carts got to the gate without stopping.

I've put you on the books for today. This is Works issue.

I can deal with the animals on the Flats. The fire elementals are the problem.

The Scoria Fire Elementals come up out of the vents and wander in straight lines, and anything they walk into burns. Last week one walked through the tool store.

The Deedkeeper says there weren't any on this island when the dwarves left. They started appearing after the day the world changed. They're on the Cinder Flats, north-east of here. Put out as many as you can.
quests.turn_in_text:
The lookout says there are fewer glows on the Flats tonight.

That's the first time the number's gone down. Take this from the yard stores.

quests.description: Kill Old Scoria on the Cinder Flats.
quests.accept_text:
There's one elemental out on the Flats that's much bigger than the rest, and it doesn't wander.

The carters call it Old Scoria. It stands in the middle of the Cinder Flats for days, and the small ones come up out of the ground around it. My scout thinks it's calling them.

It's north-east of the yard, where the crust is darkest. It'll come up if someone goes looking for it. If you can kill it, we might get some peace.
quests.turn_in_text:
The whole yard felt it go. The ground jumped and then went quiet.

Varga came in an hour ago and said she hadn't seen a single elemental on her round. Thank you. Choose whichever of these suits you.

quests.title: Brass in a Month
quests.description: Collect Ooze Membranes from the Steamvent Oozes on the Scoured Coast.
quests.accept_text:
The air off these vents eats my gaskets faster than I can cut them. The dwarves say the vents were gentle before the day the world changed.

I've found something that holds up. The Steamvent Oozes live in the steam vents and their skin isn't bothered by acid at all. A strip I cut off a dead one has lasted a month in my worst flue.

They're on the Scoured Coast, north-west of the Works, wherever there's steam coming out of the rocks. Bring me their membranes.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are just right.

I'll cut new gaskets for the whole pump engine tonight. Thank you. Have this, I made it and never got round to using it.

The only hide I've seen that doesn't mind the heat belongs to the Ashplain Basilisks. They lie on hot rock all day.

They're out on the Cinder Flats, north-east of here. Try to bring me whole hides.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's a good thick hide with no scorch marks.

I'll have it on the drum by the end of the shift. Thank you. This is from the mine head stores.

quests.description: Carry Assayer Ruddi's report to Underwriter Nix Brackwhistle in Cinderwharf.

objectives.label: the assay report, to Underwriter Nix in Cinderwharf

quests.accept_text:
I've worked out why we're short of ore, and the Underwriter won't like it.

Nobody's stealing it, because the seam is running out. Every cart is a little poorer than the last, and the upper workings will be finished within a year. The rich ore is deeper, under the Emberdeep.

I can't leave the scales. Please take this to Underwriter Nix in the Merchant House in Cinderwharf. Head east across the Flats to the town gate.
quests.turn_in_text:
I've read it twice and she's right. She always is.

So the venture needs the deep ore, and the deep ore is under a lake of fire. I'll need to think about what that means.

quests.description: Collect Yellow Fissure Crust from the Ventborn Flame Spirits on the Emberdeep Approach.

The alchemist in town has been buying something off the carters for pennies, and I want to know what it's worth.

It's a yellow crust that forms round the fissures. The Ventborn Flame Spirits come out of those fissures covered in it. If I'm right about the colour, there's gold in it.

The fissures are on the Emberdeep Approach, east of the yard on the way to the big door. Bring the crust back to my scales.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's rich in gold. I ran it twice to make sure.

Pell's been paying a copper a pound and selling it for silver. From tomorrow I'm weighing this as well, and the dwarves will be paid for it.

I can't fire a charge while something's standing in front of it.

The Crag Earth Elementals walk up out of the Emberdeep Approach and into my blast faces. I think the drilling draws them. Then I've got to pull every charge out by hand before I can try again.

The Approach is east of the red shed, on the way to the big door. Break up the ones you find before they reach my faces.
quests.turn_in_text:
I fired three faces this afternoon and there was nothing in them but rock.

Pulling a live charge is the most dangerous part of this job. Thank you, and take this.

quests.title: A Pulse
quests.description: Set Dr. Arakawa's instruments at three vents: on the Cinder Flats, on the Scoured Coast and on the Emberdeep Approach.

objectives.label: the vent on the Cinder Flats
the steam vent on the Scoured Coast
the fissure on the Emberdeep Approach

quests.accept_text:
I've told the Foreman this mountain has a pulse, and she wants me to prove it.

Before the change I had forty instruments at Sakurajima. Here I've got three tiltmeters I built from clock parts. If I put them at three vents far apart and they all move at the same moment, then one thing is moving under the whole island.

Put the first on the Cinder Flats, north-east of here. Put the second at the steam vent on the Scoured Coast, to the north-west. Put the third at the big fissure on the Emberdeep Approach, south-east of the yard. Set each one level on bare rock.
quests.turn_in_text:
All three needles moved together.

It happens every nine minutes, at every vent, at the same moment. A magma chamber doesn't behave like that. I don't know what does, and I'd like to find out.

quests.title: What the Drakes Carry
quests.description: Kill Calderaborn Drakes on the Emberdeep Approach and collect Fresh Caldera Glass from them.
quests.accept_text:
I need a sample from the lake under the mountain, and I can't get close enough to take one.

The Calderaborn Drakes roost inside the crater and swallow hot glass from the edge of the lake. Before I came through I'd have sent a drone over the rim. Here I need you to cut open a drake.

They hunt over the Emberdeep Approach, south-east of the yard. Bring me the glass while it's fresh, because it changes as it cools.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's still warm, which is what I needed.

There are threads running through this glass, like grain in wood. Molten rock doesn't do that. Something is growing in that lake, and I think it's what's making the pulse.

quests.description: Enter the Emberdeep and kill The Mountain's Heart.
quests.accept_text:
Everything I've measured points to one chamber on the west side of the lake. The Doorwarden says there's something in it.

His people call it The Mountain's Heart. It beats every nine minutes, and the fire elementals come up on the beat.

The door to the Emberdeep is east of the yard, at the end of the Approach. The chamber is deep in, on the western shore of the lake. I'm sorry to be sending you into it.
quests.turn_in_text:
All three needles stopped at the same moment.

The vents are still smoking, but it's an ordinary volcano now, and I know how to watch one of those. When the bay at Kagoshima vanished three years ago I didn't think I'd be doing this work again. Thank you.

quests.title: Where the Vents Moved
quests.description: Check Scout Varga's three marker posts at the far edges of the Cinder Flats.

objectives.label: the north-west marker post on the Cinder Flats
the north-east marker post on the Cinder Flats
the south-east marker post on the Cinder Flats

quests.accept_text:
I've got three marker posts at the edges of the Flats, and I can't get round them this week.

Each post has a rope pegged out to the nearest vent. If the vent moves, the rope goes slack or burns through. That tells me where it's safe to send the carts. I turned my ankle two days ago.

One post is to the north-west, one is to the north-east, and the third is south-east toward the town gate. Check the rope at each one.
quests.turn_in_text:
So the north-west rope has burned through and the other two are fine.

The western vent has moved toward the cart road. I'll move the road markers east in the morning. Thank you. Take this, I won't need it until my ankle heals.

quests.title: The Ventlord
quests.description: Kill Karrath the Ventlord on the Emberdeep Approach.
quests.accept_text:
There's something on the Emberdeep Approach that opens new vents wherever it walks.

I saw it at dawn on the south edge of the Flats. It came up the slope from the big door, as tall as the winding tower, and the ground split and steamed where it stepped. The Doorwarden's people call it Karrath the Ventlord.

It walks the Approach, south of here. It'll come out to meet someone who's hunting it. If it ever reaches the Works, we're finished.
quests.turn_in_text:
I watched the steam stop all along the Approach at once.

The Foreman told me to give you this when you came back. Thank you.

quests.title: The Door Was Sealed
quests.description: Hear what Doorwarden Kettil knows about the Emberdeep, then carry his door book to Keeper Morn Ashhold in Cinderwharf.

objectives.label: the door book, to Keeper Morn in Cinderwharf

quests.accept_text:
If you're going down there, you should hear what I know first.

Ask me about the seal and the day it broke. After that, I'd like you to take my door book to Keeper Morn in Cinderwharf. He keeps the old rites, and the seal on this door was one of them.

The town is north-east of here across the Cinder Flats. Morn is on the Shrine Terrace in the south-west of the hold.
quests.turn_in_text:
Kettil has written down every time the door has breathed. There are a lot of entries.

The seal was an Ashhold rite. My grandfather knew the words and my father knew half of them. I don't know them at all, so I can't close that door again. Please be careful down there.

quests.description: Collect Scourcoast Crab Meat from the Scourcoast Crabs on the Scoured Coast for the Tapped Vein's stew.
quests.accept_text:
The stew is usually whatever came off the boat, and this week nothing came off the boat.

The carters say the Scourcoast Crabs on the west shore taste smoked already, because of the vents.

Leave by the town gate and go west across the Reach to the Scoured Coast. Bring me the meat and I'll get the pot on.
quests.turn_in_text:
It does smell smoked.

The dwarves had three bowls each and the goblins asked for the recipe. Thank you. Your name's on the board, and this is for you.

quests.description: Carry Trader Gex's unmarked keg to Blaster Orrin at the Ashclaim Works.

objectives.label: the unmarked keg, to Blaster Orrin at the Ashclaim Works

quests.accept_text:
I need a keg taken to Blaster Orrin at the Works, and I'd rather you didn't ask what's in it.

He's at the red shed on the south side of the yard and he's expecting it. If anyone at the gate asks, it's pickled fish.

The Works is west of town across the Cinder Flats. Carry it level and keep it away from anything that's burning.
quests.turn_in_text:
That'll be Gex's powder.

The official powder comes over on the boat and half of it's damp when it lands. Gex buys the damp kegs as scrap, dries them out and sells them back to me. His always fires, so I don't ask questions either.

quests.title: The Landing Shelf
quests.description: Enter the Emberdeep and kill Pack-Alpha Cinderhound on the Landing Shelf.
quests.accept_text:
The venture needs the deep ore, and the deep ore is past a door I can't get a survey party through.

Just inside the Emberdeep there's a shelf of rock where a party could set up. The Doorwarden says it's held by a pack of hounds made of cinders, led by one he calls Pack-Alpha Cinderhound.

Leave by the town gate and go south-west across the Reach. The door is at the end of the Emberdeep Approach, east of the Works. Kill the alpha and the pack should scatter.
quests.turn_in_text:
The shelf is clear, so I can put surveyors on it this week.

Thank you. Here's what the Ashclaim owes you.

quests.title: Geyser Rights
quests.description: Kill Thrass, the Geyser Spirit, in the Emberdeep.
quests.accept_text:
My surveyors are on the shelf now, and they've sent back a note about steam.

There's a field of geysers on the west side of the lake that could drive every engine the Works needs. There's also something living in it that boiled one of my surveyors. The Doorwarden calls it Thrass.

The field is a short way in from the Landing Shelf, to the west. The door is at the end of the Emberdeep Approach, south-west of town. Please get rid of Thrass, the Geyser Spirit.
quests.turn_in_text:
The surveyors say the geysers are still running and nothing is attacking them.

That's free power for a foundry. Three years ago all I had was a deed nobody could reach. Thank you, and here's your pay.

quests.title: A Scale That Stays Hot
quests.description: Take a Molten Serpent Scale from The Molten Serpent in the Emberdeep.
quests.accept_text:
I've heard there's a serpent in the Emberdeep whose scales never cool, and I'd like one for the forge.

A smith spends half his time waiting for metal to come back up to heat. A plate that stayed hot on its own would save me hours. The Doorwarden's people call it The Molten Serpent.

It's in the middle of the Emberdeep, past the geysers. The door is south-west of town at the end of the Emberdeep Approach. I only need one scale.
quests.turn_in_text:
Put it on the anvil. I can feel the heat from here.

It hasn't cooled at all. It's going into the bed of my forge tonight. I made you this while you were telling me how you got it.

quests.title: What the Vents Cough Up
quests.description: Collect Sulphur Crawler Glands from the Sulphur Crawlers in the Emberdeep.
quests.accept_text:
There are crawlers in the Emberdeep that live on raw sulphur, and I want what's in them.

Each Sulphur Crawler stores the sulphur in a gland, purer than anything I can make. With it I can make an acid that will take the rivets out of those iron masks without hurting the person wearing one.

The door is south-west of town at the end of the Emberdeep Approach. The Crawlers are on the Basalt Shelf, east of the lake. Bring me the glands whole.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are perfect.

I tried a drop on one of the masks and the rivets went soft in a minute. If any of the masked dwarves can be brought out alive, we can get the masks off now. I'll tell the Keeper, and I won't charge for it.

quests.title: The Seer Who Went In
quests.description: Kill Flame Oracle Ysmel in the Oracle's Ring of the Emberdeep.
quests.accept_text:
There's a name in my rolls with no date of death, and I think I know why.

Ysmel Ashhold was the city's seer. The roll says she went into the mountain to ask it a question, the year before Khaz Varun went dark, and never came back. The Doorwarden tells me something in the Emberdeep calls itself Flame Oracle Ysmel.

She's in a ring of standing stones on the east side of the lake. The door is south-west of town at the end of the Emberdeep Approach. I'd like her to be at rest.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then I can finally write the date beside her name.

Thank you. This was kept with her roll, and I think she'd want it to be used.

quests.title: The Deep Claim
quests.description: Kill The Caldera at the bottom of the Emberdeep.
quests.accept_text:
The last thing on my shelf is a claim marker.

It's a Dark Iron stake with the Thane's seal on one side and the Underwriter's on the other. It's meant to be driven into the floor of the caldera at the bottom of the Emberdeep once someone kills what lives there. The Doorwarden calls that thing The Caldera.

The door is south-west of town at the end of the Emberdeep Approach, and the caldera floor is as deep as the Emberdeep goes. Nobody has taken the stake yet.
quests.turn_in_text:
The stake is gone from your pack, so it's where it belongs.

The whole mountain belongs to the Ashclaim now, from the gate of Khaz Varun down to the bottom of the fire. You've earned anything I've got. Take this first.

quests.title: Kin Under Another Roof
quests.description: Carry Keeper Morn's letter to Thane Morgrim in Onyxhollow, under the Black Strand.

objectives.label: Morn's letter, to Thane Morgrim in Onyxhollow

quests.accept_text:
The old Thane is at rest and the hall is quiet, and there's someone who should be told.

There's another Dark Iron hold called Onyxhollow, under the Black Strand far to the west across the sea. Its Thane is Morgrim. Our families traded before either city went quiet, and he should hear from us that Khaz Varun has a living Thane again.

It's a long way. Take the bird from the pad to Saltspur, cross to Kalimdor, and go down through the Abyssal Sands to the Black Strand. Onyxhollow's gate is at the end of the slag road.
quests.turn_in_text:
A letter from Khaz Varun. I'd been told that city was a grave.

My grandmother used to talk about the Ashholds. I'll write back to him. Tell the Keeper that Onyxhollow will light a flame for his dead as well.

quests.title: The Tide-Chart
quests.description: A Stormscale Naga Raider was carrying a chart of the coast. Take it to Coast-Surveyor Mizzi on the Scoured Coast.

objectives.label: the naga tide-chart, to Coast-Surveyor Mizzi on the Scoured Coast

quests.accept_text:
The Raider had a sheet of sharkskin rolled in its belt. It's pricked with small holes, and when you hold it up to the light the holes show this coast with a line running between the reefs.

Coast-Surveyor Mizzi is camped on the Scoured Coast and has been trying to chart these waters. She'd know what the line means.
quests.turn_in_text:
Hold it up to the lamp for me.

That's a deep-water channel through the reefs. I've been looking for it for a year and the naga knew where it was all along. Thank you, this saves me a great deal of work.

quests.description: A Scoria Fire Elemental had an Ashclaim carter's lantern fused into it. Take it to Foreman Brakka at the Ashclaim Works.

objectives.label: the melted lantern, to Foreman Brakka at the Ashclaim Works

quests.accept_text:
There was a lantern stuck in the elemental's side, half melted. It's the kind the Ashclaim gives its carters, and the brass plate on the bottom is stamped with the number nineteen.

Foreman Brakka at the Ashclaim Works signs those lanterns out. She'll know whose it was.
quests.turn_in_text:
Nineteen is Olla Burrfoot. She took a cart out four days ago and the mule came back without her.

I've had people looking for her on the Flats ever since. I'll write to her brother. Thank you for bringing it in.
